name: edgespeak
description: Private, on-device transcription, word-level forced alignment, sentence segmentation, karaoke captions, timed-transcript translation, and evidence-based speaker naming through the local EdgeSpeak CLI. Requires edgespeak-cli on macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64, or Windows x64, so it runs in Claude Code on your own machine. Needs an EdgeSpeak license; new devices get a 7-day trial.
